text: Love Radio is one of the national radio networks united by the Krutoy Media radio holding.
short: Love Radio belongs to the Krutoy Media holding

source.name: Krutoy Media official site: О холдинге (About the holding)
source.quote: Krutoy Media объединяет национальные радиовещательные сети Love Radio, «Радио Дача», «Радио Шансон»
source.note: The page itself is undated; the site footer says © 2012–2026. The holding's own owners are not named on the page.
